_about: The positive list of the testing controls (PLAN testing-controls-plan.md): every job of the workflow `KAAL` (.github/workflows/ci.yml) is claimed by a control, with the reason it is kept. A job that is not listed is not claimed (T22). Listing a job is not a retirement decision; a retirement needs the equivalence analysis and the Owner's separate decision.

hosting.judges: Hosting's own Cases, on each supported host (Windows, Linux, macOS)
hosting.needed_by: F12, F16; hosting/I10 (a Case is the same on every host)

acceptance.judges: a fresh install of the packed packages into new repositories, per host
acceptance.needed_by: F12, F16; the one place where the packed bytes are installed
acceptance.verdict: keep, one definition run per host

lane.judges: the matrix lanes Workspaces (every workspace's own Cases but Hosting's), Acceptance (Linux) and Engineering (Engineering's own Cases)

guard.judges: kaal-guard's package suites and shipped acceptance, and `kaal-guard verify`, on Linux. kaal-guard is not a root workspace, so the Workspaces lane does not run these
guard.verdict: keep; one file is also run by the Engineering lane (overlaps.json)

guard-hosts.judges: the same suites on Windows and macOS
guard-hosts.needed_by: F12, F16 for a shipped package (Guard); the host dimension
guard-hosts.verdict: keep until Guard's requirements are shown not to name the host dimension; to verify
